title: Global speed limit is per task
symptom: Two or three concurrent downloads each get the full configured cap, so the total is a multiple of the setting
repro: Set max_speed_bytes=1MiB, start two 10MiB downloads, watch the total exceed 1MiB/s
root_cause: Each Engine builds its own Limiter from EngineConfig.max_speed
fix: Own one TrafficController in the daemon; pass an Arc<Traffic> handle to every engine

title: Torrents ignore the speed limit
symptom: A torrent downloads at full line rate while Settings shows a cap
repro: Set 1MiB/s, start a magnet; speed is unthrottled
root_cause: SessionOptions.ratelimits is left at the default (unlimited)
fix: Map the global/task budget into librqbit LimitsConfig, or gate peer reads through TrafficController

title: Video tasks ignore the speed limit
symptom: yt-dlp downloads at full rate under a configured cap
repro: Set 1MiB/s, add a video URL; yt-dlp is unthrottled
root_cause: No --limit-rate argument is passed to the sidecar
fix: Pass the remaining global/task budget as --limit-rate; update it on live changes

title: Bundle parts each get their own cap
symptom: A seven-part bundle can use seven times the configured total
repro: Set 1MiB/s, add a bundle with 4 parts; total exceeds 1MiB/s
root_cause: Each part creates a separate Engine and Limiter
fix: Parts share the bundle task's budget; the controller owns the cap

title: Changing the limit does not affect running tasks
symptom: Saving a lower limit leaves current downloads at the old rate
repro: Start a download, lower the cap, watch the rate unchanged
root_cause: EngineConfig.max_speed is copied at runner start; the limiter is immutable
fix: Live limiter handle updated by SetConfig

title: Limiter can burst above the cap
symptom: A 2 s display window can show more than the configured rate after start or idle
repro: Set 100KiB/s, start a download, watch the first window
root_cause: Bucket capacity is a full second of rate and acquire runs after the read
fix: Use a smaller burst (e.g. 250 ms) and acquire before the read or bound read-ahead

title: Limiter is not cancellation-aware inside a long wait
symptom: Pause can take seconds at a low cap
repro: Set 10KiB/s, pause a task that just read a 64KiB chunk
root_cause: acquire loops with 250 ms sleeps and no token check
fix: Check the cancellation token inside acquire or race the sleep against it

title: Gzip auto-decoding can break Content-Length and ranges
symptom: Conditional: reqwest only adds Accept-Encoding: gzip when the request has no Range header, so segment GETs are safe; HEAD probes are not, and a server that gzips anyway decompresses the body while Content-Range still describes the encoded bytes
repro: HEAD a URL whose GET is gzip-encoded, then download it; or use a non-compliant server that gzips ranged responses
root_cause: The gzip feature is enabled and no_gzip()/Accept-Encoding: identity is not set; correctness depends on a reqwest quirk
fix: Call .no_gzip() on the engine client and set Accept-Encoding: identity explicitly; add a mock-server test

title: A new download silently truncates an existing file with the same name
symptom: Adding a different URL whose filename already exists overwrites the old file
repro: Create notes.txt, add a different URL that also names notes.txt
root_cause: dir.join(name) + truncate(true) with no free-name check
fix: Choose a free name or ask; only resume when the sidecar matches

title: Resume does not validate the server's total
symptom: A changed file with the same URL/ETag resumes into corruption
repro: Pause a task, change the file on the server while keeping the URL and ETag
root_cause: The sidecar match checks URL and ETag only
fix: Compare prev.total with info.total and start fresh on mismatch

title: Resume does not validate the on-disk file length
symptom: A truncated file becomes a sparse hole and the final hash is wrong
repro: Truncate the partial file, resume
root_cause: Offsets from the sidecar are trusted; set_len only extends
fix: Validate metadata.len() against the sidecar's max offset before resuming

title: A corrupt sidecar blocks the task forever
symptom: A parse error fails the download instead of starting fresh
repro: Write invalid JSON to <file>.ripdl.json, add the URL
root_cause: read_sidecar returns Err and download_named propagates it
fix: Move the bad sidecar aside and plan fresh

title: A malformed sidecar can panic or index out of bounds
symptom: A crafted sidecar with bad indices or offsets crashes the runner
repro: Edit segment indices/bounds in the sidecar, resume
root_cause: No validation of index/start/end/done invariants
fix: Validate the segment table and reject implausible layouts

title: max_segments=1 still creates two segments
symptom: The one-connection setting is ignored
repro: Set max_segments=1, download a large file, inspect the segment table
root_cause: n = ...min(max_segments).max(2)
fix: Respect max_segments=1; only clamp to 2 when max_segments >= 2

title: min_segment_size=0 panics the planner
symptom: A hand-edited config kills the runner with a division by zero
repro: Set min_segment_size=0 in config.json, start a download
root_cause: total / cfg.min_segment_size
fix: Validate at load; reject 0; keep the SetConfig guard

title: max_segments is unbounded
symptom: A hand-edited config can spawn thousands of segment tasks and file handles
repro: Set max_segments=100000, download a large file
root_cause: No hard upper bound in the planner
fix: Clamp to a documented maximum (e.g. 64)

title: StreamStalled policy contradicts its own comment
symptom: A stalled stream gets the long host-pressure leash and shrinks the gate
repro: Kill a connection mid-stream; observe the 10-attempt long leash
root_cause: The comment says StreamStalled is not host pressure, but the code returns true
fix: Decide one policy and test it; likely a short leash + link fail strike

title: HTTP per-link rate uses a hardcoded 5 s dt
symptom: Per-NIC rates read high when a tick is delayed by the uplink scan or other work
repro: Delay the watch tick (or add a slow uplink scan) and watch rate_bps inflate
root_cause: bond.sample(5.0) with the real interval longer than 5 s
fix: Measure dt from the previous sample and pass it

title: bond.record counts bytes that are later rolled back
symptom: Retries can make a link look faster than its real throughput
repro: Force a retry on a segment; per-link bytes exceed the file bytes
root_cause: record() runs at read time; rollback only adjusts the task counter
fix: Record at durable commit, or subtract on rollback

title: CLI --bond never samples the bond
symptom: Standalone bonded downloads stay at weight 1 and never use measured capacity
repro: Run ripdl download --bond; inspect link status/weights
root_cause: Only the daemon calls Bond::sample
fix: Add a sampler to the standalone engine or share the daemon's link set

title: Torrent bind rates are never pruned
symptom: A removed uplink keeps a ghost row with a stale rate
repro: Unplug a NIC, wait, run ripdl config; the old IP still appears
root_cause: bind_rates is append-only
fix: Prune rates against the live bind list every sample

title: Per-NIC chips show HTTP traffic only
symptom: Torrent traffic is missing from the status-bar per-NIC rates
repro: Run a torrent with bonding on; chips stay at zero while the torrent moves
root_cause: bond_links is fed by the HTTP Bond only
fix: Feed one LinkSet from both engines and render that

title: Idle link keeps a nonzero displayed rate
symptom: A link with 0 connections can show MB/s for several seconds
repro: Finish a download and watch the chip
root_cause: EMA decays only on the next sample; the last value is shown meanwhile
fix: Decay to zero on a fixed schedule or show the sample age

title: Quarantine can starve a link
symptom: A recovered link may never get a dial inside the 5 s explore tick
repro: Quarantine a link, wait for explore, have no peer/segment dial in that tick
root_cause: Weights reset to 1 for one 5 s tick, then are recomputed from stale rates
fix: Keep the recovered weight until a dial proves it, or extend the window

title: Bind meter counters grow without bound
symptom: A long-running session with peer churn leaks one counter per connection
repro: Churn many peers over hours; inspect memory
root_cause: counters is a HashMap of Vec<Arc<AtomicU64>> with no removal
fix: Prune closed connections or use a per-IP epoch counter

title: uTP traffic bypasses metering
symptom: If uTP is enabled, its bytes are not in bind_totals
repro: Enable uTP, compare bind_totals with the torrent's downloaded bytes
root_cause: Only TCP reads are wrapped in MeteredRead
fix: Meter uTP or document/enforce TCP-only

title: Uplink probes run even when bonding is off
symptom: Two TCP handshakes per uplink every 5 s, forever
repro: Leave bonding off, watch a packet capture
root_cause: watch_bonding calls refresh_uplinks unconditionally
fix: Skip discovery/probing when bonding is off; probe on enable

title: Hardcoded probe targets can mark a working link dead
symptom: A network that blocks 1.1.1.1:443 or 8.8.8.8:53 loses bonding
repro: Block those IPs/ports, enable bonding; the uplink is dropped
root_cause: Only two fixed targets per family
fix: Use multiple targets including the actual download host, or a configurable probe

title: VPN adapters are only partially blocked
symptom: NordLynx, Proton, Mullvad, WARP, and similar names can be bonded
repro: Install a VPN with an unlisted adapter name; enable bonding
root_cause: The blocklist is a small substring list
fix: Detect tunnel interfaces by type/MTU/route, not only names

title: extension_dir is not applied by DaemonSettings::apply
symptom: ripdl config extension_dir=... reports success but does nothing
repro: Run ripdl config extension_dir=X, then ripdl config
root_cause: apply() has no extension_dir branch
fix: Add the field to apply()

title: Total speed includes queued tasks
symptom: A queued row with a stale progress track inflates the status bar
repro: Pause/resume quickly and watch the total
root_cause: liveSpeed includes queued and trusts speed_bps
fix: Only running rows contribute; the daemon should null the rate

title: Speed graph samples on every render
symptom: The 60 s average is not time-weighted and can jitter with render frequency
repro: Force extra renders and watch the graph/avg
root_cause: sampleSpeed is called from renderStatusbar, not a fixed timer
fix: Sample on a fixed cadence or store timestamps and integrate

title: Stale upload rate after a pause
symptom: A paused seeding torrent can still show an upload rate in details
repro: Pause a seeding torrent, open details
root_cause: upload_bps falls back to the last progress sample
fix: Clear upload_bps when not live

title: HTTP bond is IPv4-only while torrents bind v6
symptom: The per-NIC model differs between protocols
repro: Use a v6-heavy swarm with bonding on
root_cause: HTTP links use IpAddr::V4(n.addr); torrents include n.v6
fix: Unify on LinkInfo with both families where supported

title: Torrent weights use aggregate rate and self-reinforce
symptom: A slow link with many connections can outrank a fast one
repro: Compare weights with the per-connection capacity test
root_cause: weights_from_rates uses total bytes per link
fix: Use per-connection capacity, same as the HTTP bond

title: Dropping a link loses its unsampled delta
symptom: Per-link totals can undercount when a link disappears between samples
repro: Unplug a NIC mid-window
root_cause: set_links drops the old Link with its delta
fix: Fold the delta before removing, or sample on removal

title: Link history follows an IP across adapter reassignment
symptom: A new adapter that reuses an IP inherits stale rate/weight
repro: Reassign a DHCP address to a different adapter
root_cause: History is keyed by IP
fix: Key by interface identity + IP

title: Explore window is too short for recovery
symptom: A recovered link needs a dial inside one 5 s tick every 60 s
repro: Quarantine a link, wait for explore, observe re-quarantine
root_cause: Weights reset to 1 for one sample only
fix: Keep weight 1 until a dial succeeds or fails

title: Concurrency shrink can race queued runners
symptom: Lowering max_concurrent does not immediately reduce active tasks
repro: Set max_concurrent=1 while 3 tasks run and 3 are queued
root_cause: Shrink acquires permits asynchronously and may sit behind queued runners
fix: Use a policy gate checked by runners, or reserve shrink permits first

title: Late progress samples can corrupt a new rate window
symptom: A pause/resume can show a spike or zero as an old reporter lands
repro: Pause and immediately resume; watch the first samples
root_cause: Progress carries only the task id, no run generation
fix: Add a run_id and drop stale samples

title: Progress map grows for removed tasks
symptom: A detached reporter re-inserts an entry after removal
repro: Remove a task while a late reporter is alive
root_cause: on_progress uses entry().or_insert_with without checking the record
fix: Drop samples for unknown ids; keep a tombstone set

title: No protocol version
symptom: A newer daemon can silently change semantics for an old client
repro: Run an old CLI against a newer daemon
root_cause: No version field in Request/Response
fix: Add protocol to the handshake and keep v1 adapters

title: No RPC message size limit
symptom: A local client can send an unbounded line and allocate memory
repro: Send a very large JSON line to the pipe/TCP
root_cause: Line reader has no cap
fix: Enforce a max request size

title: No brute-force throttle on the pairing code
symptom: A LAN device can try codes as fast as the receiver answers
repro: Script repeated /api/check requests
root_cause: No rate limit or lockout
fix: Add per-IP backoff and a failure delay

title: Pairing code appears in query strings
symptom: The code can land in browser history, proxy logs, or screenshots
repro: Use the phone page, inspect history/network
root_cause: The page builds ?code= URLs
fix: Use a header or a session cookie after one exchange

title: Update check has no cache or backoff
symptom: Every GUI launch hits GitHub; a failing network repeats
repro: Launch the GUI repeatedly
root_cause: No cache/backoff
fix: Cache the result for a day and back off on failure

title: HTTP/2 is not enabled
symptom: Requests are HTTP/1.1 only despite modern servers
repro: Inspect the negotiated protocol
root_cause: reqwest default-features=false and no http2 feature
fix: Add the http2 feature and test multiplexed ranges

title: No per-host connection limits
symptom: A host that allows two connections still sees eight range requests
repro: Download from a host with a 2-connection policy
root_cause: Gate only shrinks after failures; no learned per-host cap
fix: Add a HostPolicy learned from 429/503/Retry-After

title: No proxy support
symptom: Users behind a proxy cannot download
repro: Set a proxy environment/config; ignored
root_cause: No builder.proxy hook or config key
fix: Add proxy config and pass it to reqwest

title: No checksum verification
symptom: A corrupt download is only caught by size, not hash
repro: Corrupt bytes on disk with the right size
root_cause: Completion checks size only
fix: Optional expected hash + post-download verify

title: Dead legacy Queue module
symptom: An unused public queue with a stale TODO confuses ownership
repro: Search for Queue usage
root_cause: Exported but unused
fix: Remove it or mark it deprecated

title: Progress.speed_bps is dead for HTTP
symptom: The daemon has a fallback path that never runs
repro: Search for speed_bps assignments
root_cause: Always None
fix: Remove the field or make the engine own the rate

title: Product research claims a global speed limit
symptom: The docs describe a feature that does not exist
repro: Read the claim, test the behavior
root_cause: Doc drift
fix: Update the doc after the fix; link the matrix

title: 0 B/s renders as a dash
symptom: A live task with a zero sample looks unknown
repro: Throttle to 0 or stall a task
root_cause: speedText uses a truthy check
fix: Render 0 B/s for Some(0), dash only for None

title: Uplink spark history is never pruned
symptom: A returning IP inherits an old sparkline
repro: Unplug/replug an adapter
root_cause: uplinkHist keeps entries
fix: Prune history when the link set changes

title: Periodic torrent reconcile can stall the watcher
symptom: Every 15 s, details are fetched for every paused/completed torrent
repro: Have many finished torrents, watch tick jitter
root_cause: reconcile_torrent_records runs on the same loop
fix: Move it to a separate task with a budget

title: watch_bonding has no shutdown path
symptom: The loop runs until process exit
repro: Trigger daemon shutdown
root_cause: No cancellation token in the loop
fix: Select on the shutdown notify

title: apply_bind_weights waits on the torrent session lock every 5 s
symptom: Session creation can delay the sampler and the rate snapshot
repro: Start a torrent while the sampler runs
root_cause: self.torrents.lock().await clone each tick
fix: Cache the session Arc or use a weak handle

title: Probe retries ignore Retry-After
symptom: A 429 during probe waits a fixed 0.5/1 s
repro: Return 429 with Retry-After: 10 on HEAD
root_cause: Fixed backoff
fix: Honor Retry-After within the probe budget

title: Update and LAN traffic bypass the cap
symptom: A configured limit does not cover the updater or LAN sends
repro: Set a cap, run an update or LAN send
root_cause: Separate clients/streams
fix: Route them through TrafficController or document the exclusion

title: Settings accepts decimal counts
symptom: 2.5 downloads fails at serde with a raw error
repro: Enter 2.5 in Downloads at once
root_cause: num() accepts any finite number
fix: Validate integers client-side

title: Completion walks the whole torrent tree
symptom: A many-file torrent blocks completion on a recursive walk
repro: Complete a 10k-file torrent
root_cause: disk_size walks the root
fix: Use the session's byte totals; walk only on demand

title: List returns every task on every poll
symptom: 50+ tasks mean a large JSON response twice a second
repro: Add 200 tasks, watch GUI CPU
root_cause: No pagination or delta
fix: Add snapshot/delta or pagination

title: Read timeout is 15 s for all links
symptom: A very slow but alive link can be killed
repro: Throttle a link below one byte per 15 s
root_cause: Global client read_timeout
fix: Use the stream watchdog as the only stall policy, or make it configurable

title: Uplink scan can delay the 5 s sample
symptom: The sampler dt is wrong and the loop jitters
repro: Add a slow probe target
root_cause: scan_uplinks runs before sample
fix: Run discovery on its own task and publish a snapshot

title: ETag mismatch is only a warning, so refresh splices two file versions
symptom: A changed file with the same name and size is adopted; kept bytes come from v1 but If-Match uses v2
repro: Pause a download, swap the server file keeping size/name but changing ETag, refresh; it proceeds with a warning
root_cause: check_compatible returns a warning and retarget still swaps the ETag and keeps offsets
fix: Reject an ETag mismatch, or make the user explicitly choose re-download; never splice silently

title: Refresh does not validate the sidecar segment bounds or kept bytes
symptom: A malformed sidecar passes refresh and then panics or corrupts on resume
repro: Edit segment end/done beyond total in the sidecar, then refresh
root_cause: Only total/ranges/name/ETag are checked
fix: Validate every segment start/end/done and kept_bytes <= total

title: Refresh sidecar loses the Windows hidden attribute
symptom: refresh.rs save uses atomic_write_json directly, so the file becomes visible in Explorer
repro: Refresh a Windows task, inspect the .ripdl.json attribute
root_cause: hide_on_windows is only in the engine writer
fix: Reuse the engine sidecar writer or re-apply the attribute

title: A timed-out RPC leaks a detached reader thread
symptom: Each 30 s timeout leaves a thread blocked in read_until on a stream nobody can close
repro: Make the daemon accept but never reply; send repeated requests; watch thread count
root_cause: The reader thread is detached and the stream is moved into it; timeout only drops the join handle
fix: Use a read deadline or a cancellable read; keep the stream handle so timeout can close it

title: The bridge retries non-connect errors 20 times
symptom: A bad token or malformed reply is retried for 2 s on every worker
repro: Register a host with a wrong token, send one request; observe 20 attempts
root_cause: forward_once does not classify errors before retrying
fix: Retry only connect/timeouts; fail fast on auth and protocol errors

title: max_concurrent has no upper bound from a hand-edited config
symptom: A huge value creates unbounded runner tasks and file handles
repro: Set max_concurrent=100000 in config.json, restart
root_cause: max_concurrent() only clamps to at least 1
fix: Clamp to a documented maximum (e.g. 64) at load and at SetConfig

title: NaN seed_ratio silently becomes unlimited seeding
symptom: A hand-edited config with NaN passes through max(0.0) and disables the ratio limit
repro: Set seed_ratio=NaN in config.json, inspect ripdl config
root_cause: No finite check on load; SetConfig checks but load does not
fix: Reject non-finite values at load with a warning and use the default

title: A hand-edited LAN code can be shorter than six characters
symptom: The pairing code loses entropy and becomes trivial to brute-force
repro: Set lan_code=A in config.json, enable LAN
root_cause: The generator is 6 chars, but config load accepts any string
fix: Validate code length/charset at load; regenerate a safe code if invalid
